fact: The Data Protection Office announced on 23 June 2026 that the Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026 come into force on 01 January 2027, with a six-month moratorium and offences punishable by a fine up to Rs 100,000 and imprisonment up to five years.
title: Communiqué: Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026
